info.title: crop-yield-forecasting-karnataka-dakshina-kannada
info.subtitle: Sentinel-2 Satellite Indices + Weather & Soil Data  for Crop Recommendation in D
info.description:
This dataset supports a hybrid deep learning approach 
to crop yield forecasting and crop recommendation for 
Dakshina Kannada district, Karnataka, India.

Contents:
- Processed Sentinel-2 satellite imagery (.tif) including 
  NDVI, EVI, GCI, and Moisture Index spanning 2021–2024
- Weather and soil CSV data sourced from Google Earth Engine
- Field records with crop and soil parameters

The dataset is used to train a hybrid EfficientNet-B3 + 
XGBoost + Late Fusion MLP model targeting 90%+ accuracy 
for crop recommendation based on land and climate conditions.

Study Area: Dakshina Kannada, Karnataka, India
Satellite Source: Copernicus Data Space (Sentinel-2)
Time Period: 2021–2024
